title: Wrap a renderer with brackets
prompt: Keep the Renderer alias. bracket(next) returns a new renderer that calls next once and surrounds its result with [ and ]. Store the wrapped callable by value so the returned callable stays valid. Nested wrappers must compose.
driver: int main(){std::string s;std::getline(std::cin,s);auto render=bracket([](std::string text){return text;});std::cout<<render(s)<<"\n";}

tests.label: One wrapper
tests.hint: Wrap the returned text, not the original input only.

tests.label: Preserve inner behavior
tests.hint: Call the wrapped renderer before adding brackets.

tests.label: Empty text
tests.hint: Empty output still gets its wrapper.

hints: Return a lambda that captures next by value.
Capturing the local parameter by reference would dangle after bracket returns.
explanation: Each wrapper keeps the same calling interface and adds one behavior around the next component. Value capture preserves the wrapped callable’s lifetime.
